_README: This is the request body sent to Trae's upstream chat endpoint.
Placeholders in {{...}} are substituted at runtime; everything else is sent verbatim.
The fields below are a starting guess. To make it exact: run with TRAE_CAPTURE=1,
trigger one chat in Trae, then open captures/<timestamp>.json and copy the real
request body over this template (keeping the placeholders you need).
